enviamos_um_link_para_o_200a4: We'll send a link to your e-mail. Set your new password there and come back here.
ja_redefiniu_a_senha_cole_26a04: Already reset your password? Paste your recovery key below. We rebuild the key with the new password — nothing leaves your browser.
